questions.question: Sami calls Mina in an emergency: 'An 8-year-old child has a fractured permanent tooth with pulpal exposure!' Mina replies: 'We need to do a partial pulpotomy.' What is a partial pulpotomy on a permanent tooth?
options: Removal of the coronal pulp only
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Partial pulpotomy preserves pulpal vitality on young permanent teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a partial pulpotomy.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 10-year-old child with an impacted tooth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Impaction often requires orthodontic-surgery collaboration.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to the orthodontist.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should a baby tooth be extracted due to infection?' Mina replies:
options: If the infection is localized and treated
If the infection risks affecting the permanent germ
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Extraction is indicated if the infection threatens the permanent germ.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do an X-ray to evaluate.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a permanent tooth trauma with an open apex?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Immature permanent teeth have revascularization potential.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will try apexification.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a supernumerary tooth?' Mina replies:
options: An extra tooth in the arch
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Supernumerary teeth can cause eruption delays.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will extract the supernumerary tooth.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 9-year-old child with a severe malocclusion?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'An early orthodontic evaluation is recommended for severe malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of an ankylosed baby tooth?' Mina replies:
options: A tooth that moves too much
A tooth that doesn't move and is in infra-occlusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ankylosis manifests as a tooth that doesn't move and is in infra-occlusion.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor these signs.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with external resorption?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'External resorption may require extraction if severe.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor with X-rays.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is dental agenesis in children?' Mina replies:
options: The congenital absence of one or more teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Agenesis is a lack of dental development, often of genetic origin.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor the evolution.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with a deep cavity under a crown?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate if a repair is possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Cavities under crowns can sometimes be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate before replacing.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should a pulpectomy be performed on a baby tooth?' Mina replies:
options: When pulpotomy is no longer possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pulpectomy is indicated when the pulp is necrotic or the infection is too extensive.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a pulpectomy if necessary.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 6-year-old child with severe early childhood caries?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Pediatric crowns are indicated for severe early childhood caries.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will place crowns.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a baby tooth with endodontic treatment?' Mina replies:
options: A root canal treatment on a baby tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Endodontic treatment on a baby tooth (pulpectomy) preserves the tooth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do an endodontic treatment.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 10-year-old child with a permanent tooth with an immature apex?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Apexification and revascularization techniques save immature teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in apexification.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a baby tooth with a fistula?' Mina replies:
options: Treat or extract according to the extent of the infection
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A fistula indicates a deep infection that requires treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat or extract.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of space maintainers?' Mina replies:
options: They maintain space for permanent teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Space maintainers are essential to prevent crowding.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use space maintainers systematically.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should a baby tooth be extracted due to crowding?' Mina replies:
options: Only if it blocks the eruption of the permanent tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Extraction for crowding is only indicated if the permanent tooth is blocked.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate before extracting.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 12-year-old child with a persistent baby tooth?' Mina replies:
options: Check the presence of the permanent tooth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A persistent baby tooth at 12 years requires radiological evaluation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do an X-ray.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is minimal dentistry in children?' Mina replies:
options: Preservation of tooth structure with conservative techniques
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Minimal dentistry preserves tooth structure in children.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will adopt these techniques.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with excessive mobility?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Excessive mobility requires evaluation of the cause.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do an X-ray to evaluate.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the risks of premature extraction in children?' Mina replies:
options: Loss of space, eruption problems, and malocclusion
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Premature extractions can cause crowding and malocclusions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use space maintainers.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a 7-year-old child with an interproximal cavity on a baby tooth?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Interproximal cavities on baby teeth must be restored.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a restoration.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a baby tooth with internal resorption?' Mina replies:
options: A destruction of the tooth from the inside
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Internal resorption is a rare pulp pathology.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor the evolution.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a baby tooth with a coronal fracture?' Mina replies:
options: Restore if the fracture is superficial
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Coronal fractures on baby teeth can be restored.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will do a restoration.'

questions.question: Sami, after having tackled complex cases in pedodontics with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Emergencies and complex pathologies are...'
options: The key to preserving children's dental health
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Emergencies and complex pathologies are the key to preserving children's dental health.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
